title: Bottle jack
object: 2-tonne hydraulic bottle jack in axial section
idea: Force multiplication by area ratio (Pascal's principle)
summary: Pascal's principle in a cast base. Each 25 mm stroke of the Ø12 plunger pushes 2.83 cm³ of oil past the delivery ball and lifts the Ø32 ram 3.52 mm, so 138 N on the handle holds 1.5 t. Section A-A puts the two bores side by side, and cracking the release screw lets the load drive the oil back to the reservoir.
usedFor: Physics teaching: Pascal's principle, area ratio, work in equals work out
Product documentation for hydraulic jacks, presses and pumps
A metaphor for leverage and amortisation: many small strokes buy one large lift
views: Section A-A plan through the base 1:1
Ram lift against pump strokes diagram
controls: Drag the handle · ↑ ↓ stroke · Space pumps · O opens the release valve · L changes the load · S slow motion
